datum_tilt_check — DRIVE granular op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.datum_tilt_check(result, warn_deg: 'float' = 1.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import granular; granular.datum_tilt_check(result, warn_deg: 'float' = 1.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("datum_tilt_check"))

Usage

Judges from the return value of repose_angle_silhouette (left/right slope angles and ground tilt) whether the reference plane is tilted.

The tilt β of uneven ground (datum) adds to the angle of repose (the same trap as in the existing volume PoC). For shear type (z' = z + x tan β) the left and right slopes are atan(tan φ ± tan β); for camera roll (rotation type) φ ± β —— in both cases the left–right difference ≈ 2β, so a warning is raised when the left–right difference exceeds warn_deg. The two models differ at first order (at β = 5 degrees and φ = 30 degrees the left slope is 33.62 vs 35.00 degrees, measured), so both corrected values are returned, and which one to use is decided by the origin of the ground (the datum of a height map, or camera tilt):

phi_shear_deg (subtraction of tan, uses ground_deg), phi_roll_deg (subtraction of angles = the left–right mean itself), beta_shear_deg (β read from the left–right tan difference = atan((tan L − tan R)/2)), beta_roll_deg (= left–right difference / 2). Raises ValueError: missing field / angle out of range / warn_deg ≤ 0.
